content.comment_body: Hello, I currently have the [company_name] [product_name] software installed on my laptop, but it’s at [version_no]. I’ve received the upgrade for [version_no] from [company_name], but their instructions say I need to 'point' it to my old version, and I’m not sure what that means. Can anyone explain how to do this? I’m a bit lost.

If you have the full version (not the demo) of [product_name] [version_no] installed on your laptop, you can apply the upgrade to [version_no] without issues. There's no need to specify anything further.

analysis.insight_summary: A user is unsure how to upgrade [product_name] from [version_no] to [version_no] due to vague official instructions mentioning 'pointing' to the old version. Another user offers clarification that if the full version is already installed, the upgrade should proceed smoothly, indicating a lack of user-friendly guidance in the upgrade process.
analysis.user_expectations: User expects detailed, clear, and straightforward instructions for updating from one version of the software to another.
